response.justification: Bogdan has exceptional technical depth, open-source contributions, and diverse full-stack experience, particularly in Linux, TypeScript, and architecture design — but lacks demonstrated leadership in team management, UML expertise, and critical German proficiency (only 'Basic'), which are mandatory for this executive-level consulting role.
strengths: Strong open-source leadership with GISCollective and multiple public tools
Extensive experience in Linux, architecture, and polyglot development (TypeScript, DLang, Node.js)
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor through workshops and community contributions
concerns: German language proficiency is only 'Basic' — fails C1 requirement
No explicit evidence of managing teams or leading client-facing architecture projects
Lack of documented UML or formal requirements management experience
